Official Award Registry

Funded University Projects & Awardees

Explore peer-reviewed university grant awards, 2.5-year capacity building programs, and graduation research support recipients across international partner institutions.

Transparent Grant Index

University Research Grants & Capacity Building Awards

Democratizing high-performance AI drug discovery, computational tools, and wet-lab experimental consumables.

UKABCS research grants are awarded through strict double-blind peer review. Across the 2025 and 2026 cycles, UKABCS has funded innovative research teams across leading institutions in the UK, Egypt, Iraq, Sudan, Brazil, Saudi Arabia, Yemen, and the Russian Federation.

Scientific Excellence in Upper Egypt: UKABCS Congratulates Al-Azhar University (Assiut) on Winning the 2026 Graduation Project Grant & Welcomes Them to the UKABCS Family!

Empowering talented undergraduate researchers across Upper Egypt with bio-computational training and enhanced wet-lab chemical support over the 3-year cycle.

Future Biotechnology Leaders: UKABCS Congratulates Cairo University on Winning the 2026 Graduation Project Grant & Welcomes Them to the UKABCS Family!

UKABCS

UK Organisation for Biotechnology and Computational Science (UKABCS) is a UK-registered non-profit academic society dedicated to peer-reviewed research, transparent grant funding, and open-access scientific education.
